product_from_film: SOAR invites viewers to trade startups through trysoar.com.
explains_well: The film clearly frames a gap between valuable startups and ordinary people being able to invest in them.
unclear: Trade startups does not explain the instrument, access conditions or any step inside the product.
scenario: A generational wealth comparison leads to startup-access frustration, a phone in space and a website/QR call to action.
product_clear_basis: Trade startups and trysoar.com appear beside the phone at 12s.

scenes.action: House footage, a rising graph and mortgage news sit under wording about past generations buying houses for $30K that are now worth millions.
scenes.design: Large white text over news and housing imagery.
scenes.purpose: Frame a wealth opportunity through a familiar comparison.
scenes.evidence: 1 fps source samples in 0–4s; state changes visible, exact transition timing/easing unverified.

scenes.action: Wearable-company coverage and founder interviews sit beneath Our generation is building companies worth BILLIONS.
scenes.design: Oversized type and repeated/reflected letter shapes.
scenes.purpose: Move the opportunity from property to startups.
scenes.evidence: 1 fps source samples in 4–8s; state changes visible, exact transition timing/easing unverified.

scenes.action: Startup valuation coverage and speaker footage carry and cannot invest a dollar wording; large dollar text gives way to a sticker-covered phone back.
scenes.design: Tight text crops, distorted/reflected image areas and grainy phone reveal.
scenes.purpose: Establish exclusion and turn toward the proposed solution.
scenes.evidence: 1 fps source samples in 8–12s; state changes visible, exact transition timing/easing unverified.

scenes.action: A phone changes orientation above Earth, first near a spacecraft window and then against the planet. Trade startups and trysoar.com flank it.
scenes.design: Space imagery and a sticker-covered device, with no app screen shown.
scenes.purpose: State the offer and give a destination.
scenes.evidence: 1 fps source samples in 12–15s; state changes visible, exact transition timing/easing unverified.

scenes.action: A colored QR code is centered on black.
scenes.evidence: 1 fps source samples in 15–17.125s; state changes visible, exact transition timing/easing unverified.

sound.detail: The draft supports the houses-to-startups comparison, lack of access and until now turn. Its 30 man phrase is malformed; visible $30K supplies the on-screen wording. No validated listening; delivery, music, SFX and sync unknown.

categories.finding: Past property gains → present startup value → access gap → trade-startups invitation.
The first frame states a generational comparison over a house, giving the opening a clear subject.
Our generation suggests a broad younger audience; Trade startups names the category at 12s but leaves the transaction undefined.
Large type sizes, reflected/distorted image states and changing phone orientation are visible. Exact transition timing and easing are unchecked.
The repeated dollar/value wording connects the two generations; the phone in space gives the solution a new visual setting.
News imagery and grainy large type shift to glossy space/device imagery and a black QR end card.
Large value words are highly prominent; the offer and website are much smaller but visible.
The short draft coherently follows the comparison/access argument, with one malformed amount rejected.
Music character and structure are unverified.
Effects and their sources are unverified.
categories.reason: No validated listening; waveform peaks do not identify effects.

categories.finding: Sound sync is unverified.
categories.reason: No validated listening or paired audiovisual timing.

categories.finding: News/interview clips, graphic typography and a space/device composition are mixed; production methods and source rights are unknown.
Source duration 17.125 s; Watch metadata 1920 × 1080. Frame rate, audio clipping and export quality not checked here.
categories.reason: Parent source metadata supports duration and dimensions; visual review is sampled.

categories.finding: Visible copy communicates startup access and the web destination without sound. It does not explain the product process.
Huge value words dominate the argument, while the phone becomes the centered solution object. Its back hides the product interface.
The problem takes about 11s; the offer has about 3s and the QR about 2s.
The access barrier resolves into Trade startups, but no action/result is demonstrated.
The comparison may evoke exclusion and aspiration; this is an interpretation, not measured viewer response.
The argument is easy to follow, but a phone exterior provides no causal proof of access.
The value comparison and startup-access promise are film claims. Investment instrument, eligibility and actual availability were not checked.
The sticker-covered phone in space gives the short ending a distinct image, while the website supplies the brand link.
Use part of the device sequence to show the actual access mechanism.
categories.experiment: Turn to the screen and show a named startup, instrument label and one order/result state.

categories.finding: For Tin, keep a short problem statement but let the reveal contain a real output.
categories.experiment: Reveal the campaign asset on the screen rather than only showing a branded device exterior.

categories.finding: No human new-viewer test was performed.
categories.reason: The product summary is this model’s film-only reading.

categories.finding: Mobile preview and accessibility checks were not performed.
categories.reason: Contact sheets are evidence views, not a stated mobile preview or compliance test.

lessons.keep: State the access problem in a short, readable comparison.
try: Turn the device to show a named instrument and order/result state.
For Tin, put the actual campaign output inside the reveal.
lessons.avoid: Using an attractive device exterior as the only product demonstration.
lessons.open: Instrument, eligibility, access method, QR destination, claim context and audio remain unresolved.

comparison.story: Generational wealth comparison → startup access gap → trade invitation.
comparison.motion: Large changing type and phone orientation states; exact transitions unchecked.
comparison.sound: Short coherent ASR argument with malformed amount; no listening.
comparison.texture: News, grain, stickers and space imagery.
comparison.lesson: A brief argument still needs one concrete view of the promised action.

scope: sampled visual and story review; ASR and measured signal support; no validated audio listening
